paragraphs.text: Azax-Azog is one of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia .

Azax-Azog is a demon of terrible physical power, cruelty, and intellect. Through brute power and the actions of his terrified followers, Azax-Azog has carved out a realm that extends from the Mephidross into much of the Oxidda Chain . Azog's minions constantly battle Urabrask 's Phyrexianized monstrosities that reside in the mountains, often press-ganging them into his armies. Once he discovered that Roxith had entered his territory, the demon informed him that he would be the first to fall. While the Thane of Rot wanted more information, Azax-Azog felt he was too weak for him to respond, but he gifted him one of Sheoldred's astral coffers. He explained to Roxith how it worked and disappeared afterward. Little did Roxith know that Azog's warning was the correct solution for the coffer.
Azax-Azog is one of the Thanes who pledged their allegiance to Elesh Norn .
